description: AES-128 ECB single-block encryptor (FIPS-197), iterative 1-round/clk_en datapath, on-the-fly key expansion, unmasked composite-field S-boxes.

clock_reset.clk_en: step enable; tie 1'b1 for full-rate operation

ports.name: start
ports.note: pulse 1 clk_en beat; key/din must be stable

ports.name: busy
ports.note: high while a block is being processed

validation.golden_source: tools/golden_model.py (FIPS-197 vectors + pycryptodome / hashlib.sha256 / binascii.crc32 + bit models)
